lens: Interaction and responsive accessibility, visual evidence only. All seven pairs inspected. Scores do not establish keyboard behavior, semantics, target dimensions, or measured contrast. Parent padding is excluded. Visible account values and statuses are preserved.

Typography/numbers 8→8: secondary quota labels remain small beside bold percentages. Increase their text size slightly while preserving the numeric emphasis.

Controls/states and responsive/accessibility 8→8: individual disclosure chevrons remain visually slight beside the explicit Expand All button. Enlarge the visible chevrons and strengthen their contrast; the screenshots do not establish their clickable area.
No score drops. Three-column alignment and all displayed values remain intact.
